claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows physical units consistent with power banks but 'scrap' condition and functional state cannot be confirmed from a still photo alone

risks.risk: Internal battery cells may be dead, swollen, or unsafe (common in 'scrap' lots)
risks.proof: Video showing power bank charging a phone with visible charge percentage increasing, plus any charge-level LED lighting up
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional/dead cells, scrap value only

risks.risk: No brand/model means no way to estimate original capacity or port type (micro-USB vs USB-C vs Lightning)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any label, input/output ports, and capacity rating sticker if present
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unbranded scrap, lowest tier

risks.risk: Physical damage (cracks, swelling, corrosion) may be hidden under tape wrap
risks.proof: Photo with tape removed showing full casing and any battery bulge
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible damage under tape, worst case

risks.risk: Cables shown may or may not be included, condition/compatibility unclear
risks.proof: Photo showing cable connectors (USB-A/C ends) clearly and confirmation they're included in sale
risks.if_unproven: priced as power banks only, cables excluded from value

risks.risk: Quantity and whether 'scrap' means sold for parts/recycling only, not as working units
risks.proof: Seller's explicit text confirming whether these are sold as functional or for parts/scrap material only
risks.if_unproven: priced as scrap/parts material, not as working electronics

proof_requests: Video of each power bank charging a phone with visible battery percentage increasing
Close-up photos of any label/sticker showing brand, model, or capacity (mAh)
Photo with tape removed to inspect casing condition and check for swelling
Clarification on whether sold as working units or as scrap for parts/materials
Photo showing all input/output ports clearly
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as generic unbranded power banks in used/worn condition with no proof of function; per rules this is priced at worst case (non-functional scrap) rather than requiring further proof, since no model number is needed to identify a plain used good.
